requirements.summary: FLEET-HETEROGENEOUS-PROTOCOL: platform-neutral serializable core protocol (no OS/path coupling)

NETWORK-CAPABILITY-PROBE: per-node direct/system/user/regional/provider-proxy detection (shared/network-policy.ts probeNetwork) wired via boss:network-status IPC (direct from observed logged-in providers, user/system proxy from env config)
PROXY-ROUTE-POLICY: resolveRoute direct-first/proxy-required + fallbackAfterFailure ladder DIRECT->SYSTEM->USER->REGIONAL->PROVIDER->DEGRADE_PROVIDER (never Boss-down; degrade provider only)
KB-SHARED-SPACE: single user knowledge space, multi-node contributions (dedupe) + task-relevant retrieval
KB-LOCAL-FALLBACK: gateway offline -> local store keeps serving; writes queued; KB down never stops Boss
KB-DEFERRED-SYNC: DeferredSyncQueue durable; drain on gateway recovery (bounded attempts, offline stays queued)
ARTIFACT-BACKBONE: append-only run manifests with sha256/version/provenance + failed-runs + decision-log ref; partial failure never wipes earlier stage artifacts

RESEARCH-RP-CONTRACT: Research Contract model persisted per run (ResearchContractStore) + IPC boss:research-contract-record; section prompts expand strictly from the contract (violatesContract guard) - no free goal rewrite

RESEARCH-SUFFICIENCY-GATE: sufficiencyAudit over durable ledger evidence (claims evidence/experiments/citations/reviews; open criticism explicit) + IPC boss:research-contract-audit; missing contract fails closed
RESEARCH-CROSS-REVIEW-LOOP: six roles; structured objection->response/rebuttal->revision->re-review; major cannot be retained; meta-review approve/revise; durable ReviewRoundStore + IPC
RESEARCH-PUBLICATION-MODE: publicationReady gate (contract+sufficiency+settled review+meta) for PUBLICATION mode; ACCEPTANCE/SMOKE fast path unchanged (full regression green)
RESEARCH-ARCHIVE: stage-classified research archive via artifact-backbone (manifest sha256/version/provenance + failedRuns); later failed stage never wipes earlier stage files

SELF-ITERATION-INTEGRATION: worker response vocabulary (MODEL_DONE/PARTIAL/FAILED/BLOCKED/QUESTION, no GLOBAL_COMPLETE); self-claims advisory + downgraded; goal driver ABORTs a worker that only claims completion (rollback, never CONVERGE); real audit/build/test + verification gates remain the only completion paths
SOAK->2H: single continuous autonomous run >2h with slowdown/retry/checkpoint/degradation/continuation
UI-ISOLATION: background tasks run+complete with ZERO UI/subscribers (supervisor headless battery); durable state read by later reconnect (StateStore reopen); no UI dependency in task lifecycle

UI-STATUS-DISPLAY: Owner strip extended with module-degraded/waiting/recovery/blocked/node line (OwnerSummary.tsx from snapshot + nodeStatus bridge); provider/task states via snapshot; acceptance gaps represented by blocked+waiting-REWORK counts (documented)
SCENARIO-E: BUILD compile failure => run FAILED but literature/manuscript/citation decisions+evidenceRefs survive and are readable; failed:BUILD recorded; run not discarded (real supervisor+ledger)

SCENARIO-G composite over real modules: provider FAILED (breaker OPEN) + node OFFLINE (fleet) + KB offline (local fallback serving) + research REWORK (FAILED w/ preserved stages) — all usable work continues, process alive
FINAL-ACCEPTANCE-REPORT: manifest-generated acceptance report + legal terminal state
